ArtworkPlus

General

Restore all tabs to script defaults
This resets every setting on every tab, not just General.

Case

Overlays physical disc-case artwork on detail pages.
▶Poster size
General: one size for every kind below. Individual: each kind sets its own.
%
Percent of the normal poster size on every kind; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on movie pages; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on set pages; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on series pages; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on season pages; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on episode pages; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on every other kind; 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
%
Percent of the normal poster size on game pages (Playnite Bridge); 100 is how Jellyfin draws it (10-200).
▶Cases
Show Cases on
Unchecking all three also turns Case off entirely.
Choose between 4 different case types.
Original keeps the case as it is; Full shell tints its plastic to match the cover.
Which color the cover gives the case - the same seven ways the Three.js Case offers.
Open case
Automatic: sequence on visit; On click automatic: sequence on click; On click: manual case open/close.
ms
Delay before the case opens automatically.
°
How far the front cover swings open; 0 leaves it shut (0-180).
Spinning disc
Automatic and On click automatic: the disc spins in that sequence; On click: click the disc itself.
Direction the disc should spin in.
▶Three.js Case
In front keeps the case above the page; Behind the text lets it pass under titles and details.
%
Cover height against the poster box, and where it sits inside it; 100 matches exactly (1-200).
How far the case is turned when the page opens; 0-360, past 180 shows the other edge.
How far the case leans back, or forward with a minus, when the page opens (-90 to 90).
How far wheel or pinch may go either way, in percent of the case size; 0 does nothing (0-99).
Turns the case on its own until you drag it; Left or Right is the direction it turns.
Turns per minute - Very slow 0.5, Slow 1, Medium 2, Fast 3, Very fast 4; same on any screen.
Original is the black DVD shell; Full shell uses the case color blend.
Original is the blue Blu-ray shell; Full shell and Back spine use the case color blend.
Original is the black 4K shell; Full shell and Back spine use the case color blend.
Which color the cover gives the case when Full shell or Back spine is chosen above.
The booklet in the lid and what its cover is made of; without fanart it falls back to Black.
Spine
Elements on the spine: the movie logo, the studio logo below it, the format mark and the code.
Open case
Automatic: sequence on visit; On click automatic: sequence on click; On click: manual case open/close.
Delay before the case opens automatically, in milliseconds; 60000 is one minute (0-60000).
How far the front cover swings open; 0 leaves it shut (0-180).
Spinning disc
Automatic and On click automatic: the disc spins in that sequence; On click: click the disc itself.
Direction the disc should spin in.
▶Case Mix
When an item gets a new case and look; Every visit draws anew, the others keep it that long.
Mix pool Movies
Which types are drawn on movies; No case needs a case type beside it, none leaves the settings above.
Mix pool Sets
Which types are drawn on sets; No case needs a case type beside it, none leaves the settings above.
Mix pool TV shows
Which types are drawn on TV shows; No case needs a case type beside it, none leaves the settings above.
Poster chain Cases
Which tabs a drawn case may show, each as set in its tab; unticked ones yield to the next in the chain.
Poster chain No case
Which tabs No case may show, each as set in its tab; the plain poster always ends the chain.
No case size on
Where a drawn No case shows the poster larger, to match the size a case would have.
%
Percent of the poster's current size when No case is drawn; the anchor is the side that stays (50-150).
Clear Case color
Original keeps the case, Full shell tints it from the cover; the ticked ones are drawn per item.
Which color the cover gives this case when Full shell is drawn.
Vortex Case color
Original keeps the case, Full shell tints it from the cover; the ticked ones are drawn per item.
Which color the cover gives this case when Full shell is drawn.
Viva Elite Case color
Original keeps the case, Full shell tints it from the cover; the ticked ones are drawn per item.
Which color the cover gives this case when Full shell is drawn.
Viva Elite 3D Case color
Original keeps the case, Full shell tints it from the cover; the ticked ones are drawn per item.
Which color the cover gives this case when Full shell is drawn.
Three.js DVD case color
Original keeps the shell, Full shell tints it; the ticked ones are drawn, a DVD has no Back spine.
Three.js Blu-ray case color
Original keeps the shell, Full shell and Back spine tint it; the ticked ones are drawn per item.
Three.js 4K case color
Original keeps the shell, Full shell and Back spine tint it; the ticked ones are drawn per item.
Which color the cover gives this case when Full shell or Back spine is drawn.

Animated Poster

Animated posters never found their way into any artwork database or API and remained a fan project.
Most available posters can be found on the Animated Poster Project page.
@mouflo was the main content creator of the project, producing the highest-quality posters in the community.
He sadly passed away in 2020. All credit for this art style goes to him.
Allowed animated formats
Shared between Animated Poster and Animated Keyart below. Empty disables both.
If both are enabled and applicable for the same item, this one wins.
▶Animated Poster
Show on
Off disables this entirely. Sets use Movies' settings, but always Standalone.
▶Movies
Prefixed: moviename-typename.gif. Standalone: typename.gif. Sets always use Standalone.
Used to build the filename, e.g. "animatedposter.gif". No fixed convention - change freely.
▶For Movies show also on

Extraposter aka Character Poster (Sets)

A niche but delightful multi-image feature, see the Character Poster Sets Project page for details.
The project was later handed over to @Konon, who has since created countless high-quality, polished, hand-crafted Sets.
Naming and sorting follow character prominence, based on TMDB or general poster-chronology logic. See the full collection on DeviantArt.
Allowed image formats
Shared by Extraposter and Extrakeyart below - detached from either sub, tab-level.
If a title has candidates for BOTH Extraposter and Extrakeyart, this decides which rotation is shown.
▶Extraposter
▶Movies
Prefixed: moviename-typename1.jpg. Standalone: typename1.jpg. Folder: everything in a subfolder.
Used to build the filenames, e.g. "poster1.jpg". No fixed convention - change freely.
Only used when naming mode is "Folder".
▶Detail page
Show on
Sets use Movies' settings, but always Standalone.
Sets only; movies always use their files. First: the other source when this one has nothing.
Release date per Jellyfin's rule (date, else year), or Shuffle / Random.
Image per movie in the Set: Jellyfin's poster, or its file named as in the Custom / Animated tab.
Used for a movie without that file. None: the movie is skipped.
Tried when the first fallback has nothing either. None: the movie is skipped.
%
From the top of the poster box, 0-100. Horizontal is always centered.
%
Width as a percentage of the poster box's own width. Height follows automatically.
Sequential: in order. Shuffle: no repeats per round. Random: repeats OK.
Whether a file without a number (e.g. "poster.jpg") is picked up as the first image.
Loop: runs forever. Play once: fades back to the original after one pass.
ms
How long each poster is shown before switching.
ms
0 = instant switch. Never exceeds the display duration above.
ms
Setting this to 0 turns the delay off automatically.

LogoArt

Logo and Art customizer for detail pages: source, size and position per item type, or no logo at all.
New for person pages: a logo from the person folder, or the name in a bundled signature or title font.
▶Movies
Logo slot on movie pages: keep, hide, or replace with clearart or characterart.
clearlogo: vanilla setting; clearart: Jellyfin DB supported; characterart: custom; Hide: empty.
Used when the source has no image. None: the slot stays empty.
Used when source and fallback both have no image.
Default: item first, then its parents like Jellyfin. Any other value: that level only.
%
Percent of the vanilla slot. 100 = as Jellyfin draws it.
vw
Shifts the box in vw (negative = left, positive = right). 0 = centred like the logo.
vh
Shifts the box in vh (negative = up, positive = down). 0 = vanilla position.
%
Percent of the 16:9 box on the ribbon line. 100 = 25vw wide.
vw
Shifts the box in vw (negative = left, positive = right). 0 = centred like the logo.
vh
Shifts the box in vh (negative = up, positive = down). 0 = vanilla position.
Which dimension to scale from - the other adjusts automatically.
vh vw
Height, then optional max width (0 = auto width, follows the image).
vw vh
Width, then optional max height (0 = auto height, follows the image).
Where the image sits inside a box with a fixed max width / height.
vw
Shifts the box in vw (negative = left, positive = right). 0 = centred like the logo.
characterart in the slot. Single: "typename.ext", no number. Multi: file first, then numbered ones.
Multi-image only. Sequential: in order. Shuffle: no repeats/round. Random: repeats OK.
Multi-image only. Loop: runs forever. Play once: fades back after one pass.
ms
Multi-image only. How long each characterart image stays before the next one.
ms
0 = instant switch. Never exceeds the display duration above.

TV show characterart has official API support via fanart.tv.
Movie characterart unfortunately has no database/API support - only fan projects.
